lines.text: Earn PokéCoins and encounter Groudon in GO Pass: November!
The GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for November will be available from November 3, 2026 at 10:00 am to December 1, 2026 at 10:00 am local time.
GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe

Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: November on Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Tuesday, December 1, at 10:00 a.m. local time.
Additionally, from Saturday, November 28, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 29, at 11:59 p.m. local time, there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!
For US$7.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.
For US$9.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 10 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 11.

While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.
Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, December 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!

The GO Pass Deluxe, the paid version of the GO Pass, will also be available on the Pokémon GO Web Store! Your GO Pass Deluxe purchased via the Pokémon GO Web Store will activate as soon as the GO Pass begins.
Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: November on the Pokémon GO Web Store will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, one Premium Battle Pass, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.
Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: November + 10 Ranks will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, two Premium Battle Passes, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Pokémon GO’s GO Pass: Into the Wild runs from November 9, 2026, to November 15 2025 , and features the debut of Dynamax Meltan . This reward track has been released with the Into the Wild (2026) Pokémon GO event and will be available during the GO Wild Area 2026: Global as well.

A GO Pass is a free, limited-time progression track available during a specified period. By collecting GO Points, you can increase your rank to earn rewards. For US$14.99, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe: Into the Wild, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards, such as the coveted Silver Bottle Cap .
Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: Into the Wild on Monday, November 9, at 10:00 a.m.
You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. local time.
Additionally there is no limit on how many GO Points you can earn between Saturday, November 14 and Sunday, November 15.
From Monday, November 9, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. local time, the GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for Into the Wild 2026 will be available in Pokémon GO.

Is the GO Pass Deluxe worth it?

The free GO Pass: Into the Wild 2026 offers solid value for all players, with encounters featuring Dynamax Meltan, a Golden Lure Module, Max Particles, Rare Candy, and other useful rewards. Since it costs nothing, it’s well worth progressing through the pass during the event.
The $14.99 GO Pass Deluxe is a more difficult decision. Its value comes primarily from the following bonuses:
Silver Bottle Cap: The standout reward at Rank 100, allowing you to Hyper Train one IV stat on a Pokémon of your choice.
Additional rewards: Extra Candy, Candy XL, Rare Candy XL, Raid Passes, Max Particles, and Max Mushrooms.
Gameplay bonuses: Reduced Max Particle costs for upgrading Max Moves, additional XP and Stardust from raids, and extra Candy from completing Raids and Max Battles.
Exclusive cosmetics and encounters: Duraludon Pants, a costumed Machamp encounter, and additional Pokémon encounters.

Our verdict: The GO Pass Deluxe is most appealing to dedicated players who can reach Rank 100 and have a specific Pokémon in mind for the Silver Bottle Cap. The additional Raid and Max Battle bonuses make it particularly attractive to players planning to participate heavily in GO Wild Area.

For casual players, the free pass offers plenty of rewards without spending anything. Unless you particularly want the Silver Bottle Cap or plan to take full advantage of the premium bonuses, the $14.99 upgrade is difficult to justify.
